to keep something in your mind and bring it back later

to know what something means or why it happens
to succeed in doing something after making an effort
the way the letters of a word are put together

steps.title: Check your own work before you finish.
Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ say what you are able to do now — can / can’t + plain verb
✓ say what you were able to do in the past — could / couldn’t , and was able to for one event
✓ use be able to where can has no form — will be able to , have never been able to , would like to be able to
✓ say how good you are at something — brilliant at / quite good at / terrible at + -ing
✓ talk about the brain, memory and skills — myth, ability, talent, connection, imagination
✓ use the small words for people, things and places recycled — nobody, nothing, everyone, somewhere
